metadata.title: # Transfer 5120 ARB For Si3 Unlock Grant Milestone #1
metadata.description:
# Transfer 5120 ARB For Si3 Unlock Grant Milestone #1 
  
  ### Goal of the proposal
   This is a proposal for the payout of milestone #1 of ‘Si Her Unlock Value grant, which was approved by the Unlock DAO via onchain voting.  
   Our request is for the equivalent of 500 UDT in ARB, or 5120 ARB value at the time of [snapshot temperature check submission](https://snapshot.org/#/unlock-protocol.eth/proposal/0x642fc0c123bff0e9f66baae7d8c01723f3f6248413fcd3cc09c5cb0a2a51a5db). 
   This milestone payout is in support of the business development, marketing and content development as mentioned in our proposal. 
   We will be receiving and requesting our second milestone payout of 350 UDT to hold in UDT to receive 2 weeks after hosting our September 3rd and 5th workshops with a report.  
  
   **For Reference**  
   [Snapshot temperature check for Proposal](https://snapshot.org/#/unlock-protocol.eth/proposal/0x642fc0c123bff0e9f66baae7d8c01723f3f6248413fcd3cc09c5cb0a2a51a5db)  
   [Onchain vote for Si Her Unlock Value Grant Proposal](https://www.tally.xyz/gov/unlock/proposal/105707908655433872744445152023787988754434119265751423899816630833405223103790)  
  
  Total: 5120 ARB

  
  #### About the proposal
    The proposal contains a single call to the Arbitrum Delayed Inbox Contract's `createRetryableTicket` function on mainnet to create a `Retryable Ticket` that will attempt to execute an L2 request to the ARB token contract to transfer 5120.0 of token from the Timelock L2 Alias address `0x28ffDfB0A6e6E06E95B3A1f928Dc4024240bD87c` to the receiver's address 0x8687AB2FF3188F961828FC2131b6150Ee97Bedce - `transfer(0x8687AB2FF3188F961828FC2131b6150Ee97Bedce,5120.0)`.

    Once approved and executed, the request will be sent to the Delayed Inbox contract and a ticket is created.
    
    Note that, this function forces the sender to provide a reasonable amount of funds (at least enough to submitting, and attempting to executing the ticket), but that doesn't guarantee a successful auto-redemption. [Checkout arbitrum docs for more info.](https://docs.arbitrum.io/arbos/l1-to-l2-messaging).
    
    Thank you!

[Checkout arbitrum docs for more info.](https://docs.arbitrum.io/arbos/l1-to-l2-messaging).
    
    Thank you!

metadata.title: # Activate UDT/UP Swap Contract
metadata.description:
# Activate UDT/UP Swap Contract

This proposal will activate the swap contract that lets anyone swap between UDT and the upcoming UP Token.

As a reminder, every UDT can be swapped for 1,000 UP, and vice versa.

In technical terms, the goal of the proposal is to set the correct implementation of the UPSwap contract
to the existing proxy. We are using [OpenZeppelin's Transparent Upgradable Proxy pattern](https://docs.openzeppelin.com/upgrades).
This upgrade can only be triggered by the Unlock DAO.

The `UPSwap` contract ([source code](https://github.com/unlock-protocol/unlock/blob/master/smart-contracts/contracts/tokens/UP/UPSwap.sol)) has been reviewed by [Code4rena](https://code4rena.com/).

The contracts on Base::

- [UDT address on Base: 0xD7eA82D19f1f59FF1aE95F1945Ee6E6d86A25B96](https://basescan.org/address/0xD7eA82D19f1f59FF1aE95F1945Ee6E6d86A25B96)
- [The UPToken contract will be deployed at 0xaC27fa800955849d6D17cC8952Ba9dD6EAA66187](https://basescan.org/address/0xaC27fa800955849d6D17cC8952Ba9dD6EAA66187). This is empty for now, as the UP Token has not yet been deployed.

metadata.description:
# Si Her Unlock Value 
SI3 (See Three) is an ecosystem architecting a more accessible web. We offer tools and resources that unify and accelerate womxn and non-binary web3 professionals, their communities, and their organizations. We also have our own women in web3 community Si Her Co-Active, which focuses on developing women's web identities and personal brands, introcing public speaking opportunities, and facilitating professional growth and collaboration programming.

1 | Partnership Opportunity

We are proposing a collaboration with Unlock that aims to drive new partners to utilizing Unlock Protocol, including community leaders, podcast creators, and event organizers. For an overview of our database of 500 women in web3 communities, event organizers and creators in more detail, please see our proposal on Github.

Our specific partnership activities entail:

* Develop Si Her's membership and event NFT's, to serve as examples for the inviteees for our two events.
* Activate a #SiHerUnlockValue channel within our Common Ground membership space, which provides Unlock's tutorial videos on how to create event and membership NFT's, and additional tutorial videos created demonstrating Si Her's use cases.
* Host two virtual events: Si Her Unlock Value: For Community Leaders (August 6th) and Si Her Unlock Value: For Event Organizers (August 8th), hosted within our Common Ground space.

Online Event Structure:

* Intro from Kara Howard, creator of Si3, on the topic of value creation - as creators, leaders, and women
* Introduction to Unlock, by Unlock (Lana and Angela have kindly agreed to support these events, so it couid be great for them to join one event each)
* Si3 shares Si Her’s Unlock NFT's
* Q\&A from the audience
* Si3 closes with next steps on how to set up their Unlock NFT's

These events will be recorded and edited, and replays distributed in our #siherunlockvalue channels

2 | Why Si3

Our team comprises of highly experienced web2 x web3 marketers, community leaders and experience creators. Our bios are on Github, and here is our highlights:



Kara Howard is the Creator of Si3 and its Si Her Co-Active. She has been a women-in-tech community builder for over ten years, creating and participating in offline and online communities and over 400 speaking opportunities for women. Within Si Her, she hosted their ‘Si Her Impact Web3’ event at NFT.NYC, and hosted the Si Her Summit in February 2024, which was a 12-hour global virtual event 50 women in web3 speakers. Kara's career started as an Equity Research analyst on Wall St, and her journey toward value creation and equity in the financial world, now in its evolved form, continues.



Ksenia Stark is the Co-Founder of impact creator house ⅄Oᒋ⅋NOISՈᖵNOϽ, a collaboration strategist, and public speaker. She approaches marketing beyond commercialization, creating GTM strategies with community experiences. Their latest experiences include Berlin Pride, FutureGO Summit, Art Basel Miami, three events during WEF in Davos, including an 18-hour-long summit and gala for Lan.Space, the Global Sales Tech Festival, and BananaConf.



Stewart Rogers is a journalist, analyst, public speaker, author, startup founder, musician, and "digital nomad." As a co-founder at ⅄Oᒋ⅋NOISՈᖵNOϽ, an impact creator house, he helps creators of all kinds make an impact, connect with brands, and amplify their values and mission. As Editor-in-Chief at Dataconomy, he informs the data science community and AI community, in addition to helping create and host Europe's biggest data expert conference, Data Natives. As the Editor-at-Large at ArcticStartup, he delivers news from the startup industry in the Nordics and Baltics.



3 | Our Milestones

Milestone 1: Kickoff:

* Begin outreach women in web3 community leaders with our ‘Si Her Unlock Value’ events, and invitations to join our August 6th membership NFT event, and August 8th event NFT gathering
* Develop event NFT and membership NFT for Si Her with Unlock as use cases
* Logo placement on Si3’s new website announcing event and on social media.
* Create pre-event video sharing about Si Her's Unlock NFT's, shared across our social platforms (Linkedin, X).
* Activate #unlockvalue channel in Si Her’s membership platform with tutorial guides and videos.

500 UDT - payment requested at kickoff as we will be creating assets with Unlock's logo and sharing with our network of 200 organizations, extending information about Unlock Protocol and it's offerings and inviting them to attend our event.



Milestone #2: Event Hosting & Reporting

* Host virtual event on August 6th (target 50 community leader attendees) and August 8th (targeted 25 event organizers)
* Create post-event video with the community leaders that have Unlock NFT's and their logos, tagging them in the video for collective social sharing
* Provide metrics report on the collaboration, including total # of invites to events, total number of attendees, total number of conversions to new customers (both membership and event NFT's), # of conversations started in our #unlockvalue channel in our membership platform, and social metrics from our two videos shared across socials.

350 UDT - payment is requested at completion of this milestone on September 20th, after we have hosted the event, created post event video highlight reel, and provided metrics report

We would also like to offer free memberships to Si Her ($300 usd value each) for the four women of Unlock who we have connected with and are supporting us: Alana, Lana, Angela and Valentina. ✨️

metadata.title: # Token Listing Officer Proposal
metadata.description:
# Token Listing Officer Proposal
# Summary

This proposal grants the title of Token Listing Officer for a term of 12 months to legal name, Angela Marie Thomas, aka Angela Steffens (wonderwomancode.eth) of Olympia, Washington, USA, the authority to execute applications for the listing of the Unlock DAO Tokens (UDT) on centralized exchanges and various private and DAO run informational listing services, to follow up with associated staff on behalf of the DAO and to put up proposals if any additional funding is needed.

# Why it matters

Having UDT listed on centralized exchanges, especially in countries where they have to deal with regulatory bodies, would provide the following benefits to the DAO. 



* It gives a public perception of legitimacy to Unlock Protocol.
* It will provide much-needed visibility to the protocol it currently does not have.
* It will allow those who wish to have a future say in the protocol more options for purchasing UDT if they do not have the time to spend to earn their tokens.
* It will allow those who are doing the business of running the Unlock DAO the ability to exchange their awarded UDT for other tokens or fiat as they need, thus attracting more talent to the DAO membership.
* Over time, it should stabilize the price and reduce the wild swings we sometimes see from even low-volume activity.



Checking for listings on token informational sites to ensure they exist and are up to date provides the following benefits.

* It ensures that when applications are made to centralized exchanges, the Unlock DAO is seen as active and on top of things, giving the public a perception of legitimacy to Unlock Protocol.
* It ensures that the new governor contract at 0x440d9D4E66d39bb28FB58729Cb4D3ead2A595591 is appropriately referenced and not the old contract at 0x7757f7f21f5fa9b1fd168642b79416051cd0bb94.




It provides the additional benefit of having a single point of contact for the Unlock, Inc. team and the DAO membership to whom incoming requests can be directed.

# Why Angela

In short, trust! 



As a former member of the Unlock, Inc. staff and an active member of the DAO, she is in a unique position that few others inside the DAO are. The benefits of that position are as follows. 

* Most community members know Angela and have spoken with her online and/or in person at events. 
* Many people at some of these exchanges or listing sites have had previous interactions with Angela as the public face of Unlock Protocol during her time as Community Lead or in her activities with other DAOs and NFT projects. 
* She understands the inner workings of Unlock, Inc. and Unlock DAO. 



Some additional facts about Angela that are beneficial for this position.

* She is fully doxxed.
* She has been in a position of trust with other US corporations and international corporations. 
* She has managed legal trust accounts with millions of dollars.
* She has had full administrative access to databases with large amounts of highly regulated data (HIPAA, PCI, GDPR).
* She has passed an FBI background check as a related party to a highly regulated business in the legal marijuana space in Washington state. 



Recommendations and work history can be found <https://www.linkedin.com/in/wonderwomancode/>

# Why trust matters

We are used to dealing with trustless systems in this space. In all other instances, Angela favors trustless systems. However, this particular position requires a high level of trust from the person undertaking it for the following reasons.

* Some exchanges will require that non-disclosure agreements are signed.
* Some exchanges have rules that publicly mentioning the potential listing on their exchange could disqualify UDT from being listed.
* Some exchanges will want to see a trusted person as the one making the application and consider that when approving the listing.
* Listing sites are more likely to take it seriously when hearing information from a trusted source, and this may influence the speed or even whether we get listed in some instances.



# Compensation

Wallet address 0xFf4eC2057A4180A4Cd18FDEA144e53245e39869D shall receive 10 UDT per month while acting in this capacity. The monthly funds serve the following purpose. 

* A stipend for incidental expenses related to this position. Example, if a small fee needs to be paid to get something listed, it’s going to be faster to just get it done rather than put a proposal for $50.
* To continue to ratify Angela in this position until she is otherwise voted out by the DAO, or her term has ended, allowing her to work confidently in the DAO's interest on these matters and provide ongoing proof to any exchanges that demand it.



In the future upon receipt of confirmation that work has been completed, grants in the following amounts will be made to the same wallet address.



* 100 UDT per new UDT listing on a centralized exchange in the top 25 by volume\*
* 50 UDT per new UDT listing on a centralized exchange in the top 26-50 by volume
* 25 UDT per new UDT listing on a centralized exchange 51 or lower by volume
* 25 UDT per new UDT listing on a crypto/blockchain informational listing site or service with traffic better than 10,000 unique visitors\*\* per month
* 10 UDT per update of UDT listing on a centralized exchange
* 10 UDT per update of UDT listing on a crypto/blockchain informational listing site or service with traffic better than 10,000 unique visitors per month



Angela will be responsible for providing proof and submitting requests for confirmed work grants on a batched quarterly basis to reduce voting costs. 




\*All volume-based rankings will be taken from the exchange's ranking at the time of the funds request on the rankings from Coinmarketcap found here [<u>https://coinmarketcap.com/rankings/exchanges/</u>](https://coinmarketcap.com/rankings/exchanges/). 



\*\*Traffic rankings for informational listings sites or services will be taken from Semrush.

Set Protocol Fee for Unlock Protocol

## Goal of the proposal

This proposal sets the protocol fee in Unlock factory contracts across the following chains: Optimism,BNB Chain,Gnosis Chain,Polygon,Base,Arbitrum. 
  
The goal is to turn on the protocol's fee switch and set it to 1% (100 basis points) as [voted by the Unlock DAO on Snapshot](https://snapshot.org/#/unlock-protocol.eth/proposal/0xfb31abbb3ff6c8ef60bc3db9cd47adab0158ce1f955709f75cc2022b075dac8b).

## About this proposal

On each chain, the protocol fee for the Unlock contract is set to the specified amount 
using the `setProtocolFee` function.

## How it works

The proposal uses a cross-chain proposal pattern that, once passed, will send the calls to multiple chains at once. This pattern has been introduced and tested in a [previous proposal](https://www.tally.xyz/gov/unlock/proposal/1926572528290918174819693611122933562560576845671089759587616947457423587439).

metadata.title: Set UDT and SwapBurner in Unlock contract on Arbitrum, Base and Optimism
metadata.description:
Set UDT and SwapBurner in Unlock contract on Arbitrum, Base and Optimism

## Goal of the proposal

This proposal sets 1) the UDT address and 2) the Swap Burner contract address in the main Unlock factory contract on the following chains: Arbitrum,Base,Optimism. 
  
## About this proposal

Now that UDT has been bridged to Arbitrum, Base and Optimism, the new address has to be set in the main Unlock contract for the tokens to be distributed or swap/burned. For that, we call the `configUnlock` function with the bridge UDT address as parameter (keeping other parameters untouched).

A `SwapBurner` helper contract has been deployed on all three chains and will be added as setting to the main Unlock contract. This will enable the “swap and burn” feature of fees collected by the protocol on these chains, following the deployment of bridged versions of UDT there.

## How it works

The proposal uses a cross-chain proposal pattern that, once passed, will send the calls to multiple chains at once. This pattern has been introduced and tested in a [previous proposal](https://www.tally.xyz/gov/unlock/proposal/1926572528290918174819693611122933562560576845671089759587616947457423587439). 

## The calls

This DAO proposal contains 3 calls:

### Arbitrum (42161) 1 call

  Changes sent to the Unlock contract at 0x1FF7e338d5E582138C46044dc238543Ce555C963

# Unlock Protocol LinkedIn Takeover
metadata.description:
# Unlock Protocol LinkedIn Takeover
## Proposal Background

Unlock Protocol is already active on many channels to distribute awareness of the Protocol and its functionalities. Yet LinkedIn, the most popular channel these days to gain the attention of more Web2-anchored businesses and communities, is not being utilized. With this proposal, I want us to put out an application form for trusted individuals who see themselves running exclusively the Unlock Protocol LinkedIn account to grow our audience in this dedicated space filled with professionals from various fields to gain attraction in a space we might have neglected so far.

In the following section, I describe how I see this working, from applications and reviews to final execution. Let’s go!

**Introduction:**
Unlock Protocol stands at the forefront of decentralized access control, offering innovative solutions for memberships, subscriptions, and events through blockchain technology. Despite its significant achievements and potential, our presence on professional networks like LinkedIn is currently untapped. This proposal outlines a structured plan to rejuvenate Unlock Protocol's LinkedIn account, aiming to enhance visibility, engage the community, and showcase our accomplishments and developments.

## 1 | Management Selection Process

**Objective:**
Identify and select a trustworthy individual (ideally from the community) with a strong understanding of Unlock Protocol, excellent communication skills, a passion for blockchain technology, and a track record in handling social media accounts to manage the Unlock Protocol LinkedIn account.

**Selection Process:**
A process needs to be defined to select such a capable individual. I propose the following:

* Call for Applications: Open a submission period of three weeks where interested individuals/ community members can apply for the role. The announcement should be published on all available platforms including a paragraph post.
* Applicants should submit a brief overview of their experience with social media management, particularly on LinkedIn, along with a sample post they would want to create for Unlock on LinkedIn.
* Evaluation Criteria:
  // Understanding of Unlock Protocol: Demonstrates a deep understanding of our technology, mission, and community.
  // Social Media Expertise: Proven experience in managing LinkedIn accounts, especially for technology or blockchain-oriented organizations.
  Creativity and Engagement: The ability to identify compelling content from our existing sources that aligns with the LinkedIn audience and can be explained in a fresh way that is more suitable for the platform.
  // Strategic Vision: Clear, innovative ideas for leveraging LinkedIn to enhance Unlock Protocol's visibility and community engagement.
* Selection Committee: To finally select the person who will handle the Unlock Protocol Social Media, we should form a small committee comprising DAO members to review applications and select the most suitable candidate based on the outlined criteria above.

## 2 | Responsibilities and Content Strategy

**Objective:**
Ensure consistent, engaging, and informative content on Unlock Protocol's LinkedIn account, reflecting our achievements, updates, and community endeavors by linking to product information and highlighting individual members.

**Responsibilities:**

* Curate and post regular updates about Unlock Protocol, provided by Unlock Labs and Unlock DAO, including technical developments, partnerships, event participation, and major milestones.
* Highlight stories from the community, showcasing how users and partners leverage Unlock Protocol in novel ways by sourcing from existing pages such as Paragraph.xyz and Unlock’s blog as well as showcases.
* Engage with our audience by responding to comments, facilitating discussions, and expanding our network on LinkedIn. All relevant connections should be brought to the partnership team at Unlock Labs.
* Collaborate with the Unlock team and DAO to gather insights and content worth sharing.
* Monthly update on the performance of the LinkedIn account and manual addition of the statistic overview to the DAO Actions Protocol.

To state this clearly, I don’t expect the responsible individual to create new content from scratch; rather, I would suggest they distribute and share already existing content with their own words and on-brand that are suitable for a platform like LinkedIn and its native audience.

## 3 | Compensation and Performance Evaluation

**Compensation:**
I suggest rewarding the selected individual with 50UDT/ month. If and when growth can be traced, I suggest we use the following milestones to provide bonuses to the individual who is responsible for the accounts growth:

**Bonuses for threshold reached (one time):**

* 500 - 1000 followers: 100UDT
* 1000 - 2500 followers: 150UDT
* 2500 - 5000 followers: 200UDT
* 5000 followers: 250UDT

With this scheme, I want to gamify the goals of this work into achievements and hope the responsible individual will see this as a desirable challenge.

**Performance Evaluation:**
To ensure the work is being done, we should have two parameters in play:
A monthly growth report submitted by the responsible individual that indicates growth for the following parameters:
// Followers
// Engagement rates (likes, comments, shares)
// Content posting frequency.
// Qualitative measures such as audience feedback if it stands out

**Note**
If we don’t see any growth after regular postings in three months, we should reconsider whether this role is required.



More details: <https://discord.com/channels/462280183425138719/1227316800690327593>

metadata.description:
Set Uniswap oracles for UDT and most used ERC20 tokens

## Goal of the proposal

This proposal sets Uniswap oracle in Unlock factory contracts across the following chains: Optimism,Polygon,Base,Arbitrum. 
  
The goal is twofold: 1) enable the distribution of UDT for referrers when buying keys and 2) better calculation of the Gross Network Product (GNP) by taking into accounts the most commonly used tokens.

## About this proposal

On each chain, wrappers for Uniswap oracle contracts have been deployed. An oracle is used to guess the current exchange rate of a specific token pair (for instance ETH/USDC).

The same oracle contract can be used for any pairs, with the limitation that there needs to be an existing / active Uniswap pool for that pair. Three different contracts are used to query the rate for the three tiers of [Uniswap pool fees](https://docs.uniswap.org/concepts/protocol/fees). Fee amounts are hundredths of the basis point so 100 fee unit is 0.01%, 500 is 0.05%, and 3000 is 0.3%.

For each token, the working oracle is selected and added to the Unlock contract 
using the `setOracle` function.

## How it works

The proposal uses a cross-chain proposal pattern that, once passed, will send the calls to multiple chains at once. This pattern has been introduced and tested in a [previous proposal](https://www.tally.xyz/gov/unlock/proposal/1926572528290918174819693611122933562560576845671089759587616947457423587439).

# Transfer 8200 ARB To Fund Unlock Protocol’s Ecosystem via Grants Stack
  
  ### Goal of the proposal
   This proposal requests to use 8200 ARB from the tokens given to Unlock Protocol DAO by ArbitrumDAO to fund the retroQF round on Grants Stack for projects building on Unlock Protocol.
  
  #### Current situation of DAO's ARB Tokens
    - total: 75000.0 ARB.
    - DAO ALIAS Address (On Arbitrum): [0x28ffDfB0A6e6E06E95B3A1f928Dc4024240bD87c](https://arbiscan.io/address/0x28ffDfB0A6e6E06E95B3A1f928Dc4024240bD87c)

  For Reference
  [Snapshot temperature check for Retro QF Grants Round](https://snapshot.org/#/unlock-protocol.eth/proposal/0xaa142e599d981f0b58c3ac1a51af9f9a52fb5307f27d791ecc18c4da69eeacc3)
  
  In addition to the 7k ARB tokens requested for funding Unlock Ecosystem projects, an extra 1200 ARB is requested for compensation for the round management according to the following breakdown:
  
  7000 ARB - Matching fund
  700 ARB (10%) of matching fund to the round manager - lanadingwall.eth
  500 ARB for research and technical assistance - dannithomx.eth  
  Total: 8200 ARB

  [Snapshot temperature check for 8200 ARBs](https://snapshot.org/#/unlock-protocol.eth/proposal/0x4fa320e553e6992506cd31d7c0b2013e1548c646baba02d657f3a7b198140c25)
  
  #### About the proposal
    The proposal contains a single call to the Arbitrum Delayed Inbox Contract's `createRetryableTicket` function on mainnet to create a `Retryable Ticket` that will attempt to execute an L2 request to the ARB token contract to transfer 8200.0 of token from the Timelock L2 Alias address `0x28ffDfB0A6e6E06E95B3A1f928Dc4024240bD87c` to the [grants contract](https://arbiscan.io/address/0x00d5e0d31d37cc13c645d86410ab4cb7cb428cca) - `transfer(0x00D5E0d31d37cc13C645D86410aB4cB7Cb428ccA,8200.0)`.

    Once approved and executed, the request will be sent to the Delayed Inbox contract and a ticket is created.
    
    Note that, this function forces the sender to provide a reasonable amount of funds (at least enough to submitting, and attempting to executing the ticket), but that doesn't guarantee a successful auto-redemption. [Checkout arbitrum docs for more info.](https://docs.arbitrum.io/arbos/l1-to-l2-messaging).
    
    Thank you!
